hypothesis: The selected current V18 parser/canonicalizer bytes remain strict-green on the self-hosted Ubuntu proxy, and the prior evidence-loss window can be removed by making evidence sealing/upload a fail-closed part of the same execution lane.
strongest_counterhypothesis: A green replay plus durable artifact still does not satisfy the registered Andreas Ubuntu target requirement, and artifact durability itself cannot promote parser/canonical semantics.

exactly_one_out_of_box_experiment.name: EVIDENCE_SINK_LESION_RESCUE
exactly_one_out_of_box_experiment.rescue_change: Require the three core evidence files, seal them into a visible tarball, record its SHA-256, and configure upload-artifact with if-no-files-found=error.
exactly_one_out_of_box_experiment.interpretation: Scientific execution success and durable evidence availability are separable properties. A release-relevant lane should fail closed when the evidence sink is absent even if the computation itself passed.

external_primary_evidence_effect: Current GitHub Actions documentation treats the upload-artifact digest as the SHA-256 identity used for artifact validation on download.

Current SLSA build guidance treats provenance existence, output digest identity and how the artifact was produced as distinct requirements; durable evidence therefore strengthens traceability but does not create semantic or target authority.

adjudication.reason: The exact current V18 component bytes now have durable self-hosted Ubuntu proxy replay evidence, but the current workspace and prior formal closure law still require the registered Andreas Ubuntu developer-system target receipt for formal WP02 acceptance.

architecture_delta: NO_CLAYCODE_SEMANTIC_CHANGE. Harden evidence transport so scientific PASS cannot silently coexist with missing durable artifacts.
next_falsifier: Run the current exact WP02 closure on the registered Andreas Ubuntu developer-system target and bind the target receipt to the same selected component identities or an explicit successor identity bridge before changing CC-WP-02 from OPEN.
